name: attestation-issuer
description: A reusable attestation issuer: an organisation states a narrow, checkable fact about an account, and any application can verify it without reaching the organisation's data.

scripts.format: prettier --write src verify test public/*.ts scripts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src verify test public/*.ts scripts
scripts.pack:verifier: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir dist/verify pack --pack-destination ..
